summary.problem: Gemini CLI extensions cannot be installed from repository URLs using ssh:// or git+ssh:// protocols, failing with 'Install source not found.'
summary.root_cause: The inferInstallMetadata function in packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts checks URL prefixes to identify git sources, but does not include ssh:// or git+ssh://. As a result, SSH repository URLs are treated as local file paths and fail when checking if the path exists on disk.
summary.context: When running 'gemini extensions install <source>', inferInstallMetadata determines whether the source is a remote git repository or a local directory.

steps: Update the inferInstallMetadata function in packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts to check for ssh:// and git+ssh:// prefixes alongside existing git URL prefixes (http://, https://, git@, sso://, github:, gitlab:).

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Passing an ssh:// or git+ssh:// URL to inferInstallMetadata should return an ExtensionInstallMetadata object with type set to 'git' and source preserving the original SSH URL.
verification_steps: Add unit tests for inferInstallMetadata in packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.test.ts testing that ssh:// and git+ssh:// URLs return { source, type: 'git' }.

github_metadata.title: Gemini Extension can't be installed from ssh repository
